rules.msg: WEB Insecure Deserialization - Java serialized object (base64 rO0AB) in request body [high]
rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB Insecure Deserialization - Java serialized object (base64 rO0AB) in request body [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.request_body; content:"rO0AB"; fast_pattern; pcre:"/rO0AB[A-Za-z0-9+\/]{8,}/"; classtype:web-application-attack; metadata: asset_category web-mixed, owasp A08-Software-and-Data-Integrity-Failures, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0002, mitre_tactic_name Execution, mitre_technique_id T1059, mitre_technique_name Command-and-Scripting-Interpreter, kill_chain Exploitation, confidence high, signature_severity Critical, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9160001_java-serialized-b64/poc.sh, tag deserialization, created_at 2026_05_19, updated_at 2026_05_19, author huntingyuk; sid:9160001; rev:1;)

description.attack: Insecure deserialization Java: penyerang mengirim objek Java ter-serialisasi (ysoserial gadget) yang langsung mengeksekusi perintah saat di-deserialize.
description.impact: Remote Code Execution penuh di server aplikasi Java.
description.detects: Magic base64 `rO0AB` (header serialisasi Java AC ED 00 05) di body request — tidak pernah ada di data jinak.
